name: Miko Click and Collect
subtitle: In-store pickup at checkout, tracked through to collection
introduction: Let shoppers collect in store, and track every pickup order from placed to collected.
details: Let shoppers collect in store instead of waiting on delivery. Pickup appears at checkout on any store, listing your locations with their opening hours, preparation time and collection notes, so the shopper picks the one that suits them. Every pickup order arrives in one dashboard with its own status, from confirmed through packing to ready and collected. Your team moves an order along in one click and the shopper is emailed the moment it is ready. Uses the locations you already have.
features: Shoppers choose in-store pickup and their location during checkout.
Set opening hours, preparation time and collection notes per location.
Track pickup orders through confirmed, packing, ready and collected.
Email shoppers automatically when their order is ready to collect.
Handle pickup orders from the order page without leaving your admin.

testingInstructions:
Install on a development store that has at least one location and one product in stock at it.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ FIRST: this app works on every plan, not only Plus. It has two pickup methods and the default one needs no checkout extension.
1. Default method (all plans): the app switches on the store's own local pickup for each location you link, so the pickup option and the location list are rendered by the platform inside checkout. No theme edit, nothing for the shopper to bypass.
2. Optional method: our own pickup rates plus an in-checkout selector. The selector renders only on Plus. The app detects the store's plan and tells the merchant this in Settings, and steers non-Plus merchants to method 1.
Please do not restrict this listing to Plus merchants. The checkout UI extension is an optional enhancement, not how the app works.

Walkthrough
1. Open the app. On Locations choose Import from Shopify to bring in your store locations as pickup points, or add one manually and link it to a location.
2. Each location: set opening hours, preparation time and collection notes. Note the warning if the location has no street address, because the platform will not offer a location it cannot place on a map.
3. Go to your storefront, add an in-stock product to the cart and open checkout. Choose Pickup. Your location appears with distance and the preparation time you set.
4. Complete the order. It appears in the app under Orders within a few seconds, tagged click-collect, with the pickup location on the order.
5. Move the order from confirmed to packing, then to ready. Marking it ready emails the shopper. Then mark it collected.
6. Settings: switch the pickup method, set who emails come from, and toggle which progress steps your team uses.

The app reads order and customer name, email and phone only to show the merchant who is collecting and to email that shopper when their order is ready. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

allowedPricingTerms.paid: Reserved for describing the SHOPPER paying the MERCHANT, which is the trigger for a pickup order. Never our own price.
allowedPricingTerms.fee: The app lets a merchant add their own collection surcharge for shoppers, the way a supermarket does. It is the merchant's charge to their customer, not what the merchant pays us. Not used in the current copy, allowed so the feature can be named if the copy changes.
